$comment: The demo marketplace scripts/demo-data.sh builds through the product (docs/runbooks/demo.md). Every business, person and listing is FAKE. No place names here (region-neutral rule): {city} and {province} are filled from the market the run targets. Prices in cents (CAD), durations in minutes. Keys are stable: re-runs find what an earlier run made by them.

applicant.role: an account with no business yet: the live seller-onboarding demo

customers.role: the presenter's shopper (past orders, bookings, reviews)

activity.$comment: Orders and bookings the customers place so dashboards, order lists and reviews have data. buy = product listings (merchantKey.listingKey × qty); book = services; review = after a completed booking.

review.text: Spotless kitchen and bathrooms, and they were right on time. Booking again next month.
Best fade I've had in years. Quick, friendly and easy to book.
Patient tutor, my daughter finally gets fractions. Wish there were more evening slots.
